_readme: The independent variable: the SET OF MODELS compared on the local (Lemonade/llama.cpp, Strix Halo 'helios') platform. Fields per entry: 'id' (short label for trial ids/results), 'served_model' (the id Lemonade reports at /api/v1/models and the agent selects), 'model_path' (Lemonade's exact .checkpoint, verified live by serve_model), 'context_length', 'max_tokens', and the model's own vendor-recommended 'sampling'. The three chosen for the coding exercise: the Qwen3-Coder specialist, the Qwen3.8-27B lineage baseline (matches compare-agents/compare-platform), and the largest generalist Qwen3-Next-80B. Lemonade holds several installed models and loads on demand, so `make run-all TARGET=local` iterates the whole set. Sampling values coincide because all three are Qwen3 non-thinking/instruct (Qwen's recommendation: temp 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, repetition_penalty 1.05).
